thread:
alex: Heads-up — master CI is red after the last merge (PR #2147). Pre-commit is failing on multiple hooks: pyright, eslint, and rustfmt. Seen by anyone else?

ci-bot: Build #5823 failed • https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5823 • failing steps: pre-commit ➜ check-types, lint:frontend, fmt:rust

jess: yup I saw an eslint error from the frontend bundle: `shared/ui/button.tsx` complaining about `window` — probably a server-side render path missing a guard. error snippet:```error
shared/ui/button.tsx:12:5 - "window" is not defined
  10 | export function Button() {
  11 |   // SSR guard
> 12 |   if (window.matchMedia(...)) return <Small />
     |   ^
```

sam: pyright is failing in the backend after proto regen. Error looks like:```text
backend/gen/protos.py:42: error: "Iterable" not valid for "None" (reportGeneralTypeIssues)
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```Looks like the generated stubs assume non-None but the generator changed.

anya: this smells like the codegen bump from yesterday (author @mike). Can someone bisect to the commit that introduced the proto/stub change?

alex: I'll run a quick bisect on master -> suspect range is last 10 commits. If anyone can rerun the CI while I bisect, that'd be helpful (sometimes it's flaky). @ryan can you queue a retry?

ryan: queued a retry: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5823/retry — also kicked off a targeted job for backend/types only.

alex: bisect update: narrowed to commit `176b2c7` (proto-generator: bump mypy-stub shape) — that commit updated optionality in several generated fields. Reverting that change locally fixes pyright. Preparing a rollback PR (draft).

sam: I can patch the generator's typing for the interim (make fields Optional[..., None]) and push a quick fix if alex's rollback will take longer.

jess: I pushed a small change to wrap the window access with `typeof window !== 'undefined'` — should fix the eslint SSR error, I'll open PR.

ci-bot: Retry Build #5823 (retry 1) completed — partial: pre-commit still failing on types (backend), lint:frontend now passed.

alex: created rollback PR #2150 that reverts the generator typing bump; also added a test to catch this case. Requesting review from @sam for types and @jess for the frontend guard.

sam: reviewing now. If CI is green after rollback + frontend fix, we can merge and cut a patch.

ci-bot: Build #5831 (PR 2150) queued • running pre-commit checks...

ci-bot: Build #5831 passed • all checks green ✅

alex: Merged PR 2150 and cherry-picked to release branch. Thanks for the quick responses everyone. Follow-up: we'll add a small pre-commit check to detect generated-stub shape changes that could break pyright.

jess: nice. I'll follow up with a short note in #eng about SSR guard patterns for shared/ui. :+1:
